messages:
Evan Brooks: Hey all, Evan here 30nd excited to join. Trying to set up a quick ML dev VM in asia-south1 but getting a 403 when enabling KMS CMEK. Okta/Google sign-in works. Who handles project provisioning and CMEK enablement for APAC?

Priya Shah: Welcome Evan :wave: You likely don't have `cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` or project creation perms. Are you trying to use an existing project or create `redwood-apac-experiments`?

Evan Brooks: Planning to create `redwood-apac-experiments`. Command fails with `Permission denied (403) calling resource: cloudresourcemanager.projects.create`. Also when trying to `gcloud kms keys create` it errors with `Permission denied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`.

Priya Shah: OK. I can request project creation and add KMS roles. @setup-bot can you open PROJ ticket and add ap-south1 quotas and enable Compute, KMS, and Container Registry? Tag owner: evan@redwood.ai.

setup-bot: Ticket created: PROJ-2026-12034 52Provision redwood-apac-experiments for evan@redwood.ai. Billing: 01A2B3-C456D. APIs: compute.googleapis.com, cloudkms.googleapis.com, containerregistry.googleapis.com. Regions allowed: asia-south1, ap-southeast1. ETA: 6 hours (can escalate).

Helena Gomez: Evan, for quick demos I can add you to the shared `apac-scratch` project with a pre-configured key ring. If you need CMEK on disks, I'll need to grant the GCE service account and your user `roles/compute.admin` for the disk operations.

Evan Brooks: That would be great, thanks Helena. Also need read access to S3 logs in apac-telemetry (acct 777666555444) and cloudwatch dashboards. Which group should I join?

Priya Shah: Add to `aws-apac-logs-readers` group for S3 and `cloudwatch-readers` for dashboards. @infra-ops-bot can you queue that?

infra-ops-bot: Access request queued: add evan@redwood.ai to groups [aws-apac-logs-readers, cloudwatch-readers] in account 777666555444. No manager approval required.

Helena Gomez: Quick checklist for you once project exists: (1) confirm billing `gcloud beta billing projects link --billing-account=01A2B3-C456D --project=redwood-apac-experiments` (2) enable Workload Identity for GKE if using pods for KMS (3) grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key ring for `gke-sa@redwood-apac-experiments.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

Evan Brooks: Thanks. One more thing: I'm seeing org policy block on external IPs in asia-south1 when creating VMs. Is there a whitelist I can request? VM create error: `Creation failed: OrgPolicyConstraint: compute.disableExternalIpAddresses`.

Priya Shah: We disallow external IPs by default for APAC. For short-lived dev VMs you can request exception: open a policy-exception ticket with justification. Helena, can we grant Evan a temporary exception for `redwood-apac-experiments`?

Helena Gomez: I can approve a scoped exception for 24 hours if it's just for a demo and you use SSH via bastion. Send me the justification here and I'll file the exception.

Evan Brooks: Filed request in the ticket: "short demo, needs external PIP to pull large public dataset (10GB) and then will remove IP and use bastion for future work."

setup-bot: PROJ-2026-12034 updated: added exception request for external IPs.

infra-ops-bot: Group updates applied: evan@redwood.ai added to aws-apac-logs-readers. S3 access should propagate within 5-10 minutes.

Evan Brooks: S3 list works now (thanks!). Will wait for project creation and KMS role. Appreciate the fast responses :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: If anything stalls, ping me. Also here's a quick command to verify your mapped account: `gcloud auth list && gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-apac-experiments` once the project exists.

Helena Gomez: Noted. Welcome aboard Evan!

Evan Brooks: Thanks everyone, excited to be here :rocket:
